Mattos Designs Builder Instructions

Create xLights moving head models for your Mattos Designs fixtures in six steps.

Open the Builder
Before you start

Delete your existing moving head models

In xLights, delete all existing moving head models and groups before importing new ones. Leftovers will conflict with the new import and break the way the heads work. This includes:

  • Models named MH1, MH2, …
  • The MH Dimmer, MH Pan, MH Shutter and MH Tilt string groups (and any other MH string groups)
  • Group - MH ALL

You also need xLights 2026.09 or newer. Earlier versions can't import multi-model .xmodel files.

Step 1

Fixture

Choose your Mattos Designs moving head from the dropdown. Its channel layout, motor settings and colors load automatically. There is nothing else to enter.

Step 2

Model

Pick the Quantity of heads, from 1 to 8. This is how many heads will be added to your layout. The limit of 8 comes from the xLights Advanced Moving Head effect, which supports at most 8 fixtures at a time.

Step 3

String Groups

String Groups let you control one function (such as Dimmer) on every head from a single place.

  • Leave Dimmer, Shutter, Pan and Tilt checked. They are the most commonly used.
  • Tick any extras you want (such as Color, Gobo, Prism, Focus or Frost). Only functions your fixture has are listed.
Step 4

Pan motor parameters

  • Pan Direction is already set for your fixture. If you want to double-check it, click the ? button for the test.
  • Head orientation at rest: choose which way the head points when powered on, as seen from in front of the stage (Right, Left, Front or Back). The picture rotates to match your choice.
  • Options marked (Recommended Position) suit your fixture's pan direction. Grayed-out options aren't recommended.
Step 5

Tilt motor parameters

Tick Mount → Upside Down if your fixtures are hung upside down (for example from a truss or roof). Leave it unticked for heads sitting on the ground.

Step 6

Output

Click Generate and Download xmodel. A file named like 4 heads MH.xmodel is saved to your Downloads folder.

Then, in xLights

Import your heads

  1. Make sure the old moving head models and groups are deleted (see the top of this page).
  2. Open the Layout tab and click the Import icon.
  3. Drag a box on the layout where you want the heads, then choose your .xmodel file from your Downloads folder.
